mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS productTotal, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'ON_SALE' AND audit_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS productOnSale FROM product WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING_SHIPMENT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingShipmentOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedOrders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('PENDING_SHIPMENT', 'PENDING_RECEIPT', 'COMPLETED') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS salesAmount FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId}

SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, total_amount AS totalAmount, status, created_at AS createdAt, receiver_name AS buyerName, CASE WHEN receiver_phone IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(receiver_phone) >= 7 THEN CONCAT(LEFT(receiver_phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(receiver_phone, 4)) ELSE receiver_phone END AS buyerPhoneMasked FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, name, main_image AS mainImage, price, stock, status, audit_status AS auditStatus, sales, created_at AS createdAt FROM product WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
